takeaway: False statement: the coronary arteries arise immediately ABOVE the aortic valve, not below. RCA: marginal and posterior interventricular; LCA: anterior interventricular and circumflex.

lines.text: After surgery, a patient has a heart attack. Which statement about cardiac blood supply is false?
The false one says the coronaries arise just below the aortic valve. In fact, they arise immediately above it.
lines.say: (clears throat) The false one says the coronaries arise just below the aortic valve. In fact, they arise immediately above it.

lines.text: The right coronary artery divides into marginal and posterior interventricular branches.
The left coronary artery divides into anterior interventricular and circumflex branches.
Whichever artery gives the posterior descending artery defines dominance.
Seventy percent of hearts are right dominant, 20% co-dominant, and 10% left dominant.
lines.say: Seventy percent of hearts are right dominant, twenty percent co-dominant, and ten percent left dominant.

lines.text: So remember: the coronaries arise above the aortic valve.
